title: Source-local Q3 cutoff-tail scalar energy envelope
question: Can a cutoff tail restricted to one source-support edge be bounded by a source- and volume-independent fourth power of the local shifted Q3 potential, while finite matrix quotients are stress-tested separately?
method: Load the EXP-001190 -> EXP-001189 -> EXP-001188 fixture lineage so the Q3 coefficients, graph volumes, oscillator dimensions, beta values and cosine cutoff are inherited rather than recopied.

For arbitrary contractions |u|<=|x| and |v|<=|y|, bound each nonnegative bond by (c+lambda)(1+x^4+y^4), then use the exact negative-mass square completion to show 1+x^4+y^4 <= (8/g) k_pot for k_pot=1+v(x)+v(y)+2r^2/(4g).
Combine the two bond bounds without assuming contraction monotonicity to obtain |B(x,y)-B(u,v)| <= 16(c+lambda)k_pot/g and raise the nonnegative scalar inequality to the fourth power.

Rebuild the finite Q3 matrices and replace the bond coordinates only on the source edge (0,1); evaluate the local and full shifted-H fourth-power quotients, the beta/2 two-slice moment, and cutoff contraction on every inherited volume, beta and radius row.
Run primary and non-importing independent lanes and compile Lean R350 for the rational inequality composition; preserve the kinetic/operator and thermodynamic boundary explicitly.
finding: Primary 2708/2708 and independent 2597/2597 assertions pass; the integrated verifier passes 22/22 with Lean R350 PASS. The scalar rows cover 1225 contraction combinations and the finite matrix rows cover 30 source-edge Q3 cases. For the inherited coefficients c=3/5, lambda=1/10, g=3/5, r=-1, the exact factors are 8/g=40/3, tail factor 16(c+lambda)/g=56/3, fourth-power constant 9834496/81, and onsite residual -11/9. The largest local quotient constant is 0.373093179369161, largest full quotient constant 0.3730931793691604, largest equal-time fourth moment 4.9841385598184536, largest beta/2 two-slice moment 4.978096490313759, largest local Gibbs K^4 moment 112.96320576139173, and largest full Gibbs K^4 moment 2066.1832202572123. These finite values are diagnostics only.
decision_reason: The source-edge cutoff tail has a genuinely local scalar fourth-power envelope whose constant is independent of total volume and source contraction. The finite local/full quotient rows show how the kinetic noncommutativity enters without being hidden. This advances the potential input for the OS/KMS-facing tail lane but does not convert the scalar bound into an operator order or a uniform Gibbs moment.

adversarial_review.check: Both scalar factors are explicitly constrained by absolute-value contraction; no cutoff monotonicity is used.
The bond is a sum of nonnegative quadratic and quartic terms, so the tail difference is bounded by the sum of the two envelopes; no false ordering B(u,v)<=B(x,y) is assumed.
The r=-1 contribution is retained through the exact square-completion residual -11/9 rather than discarded.
The factor 56/3 and constant 9834496/81 are recomputed from the manifest inputs and cross-checked by Lean R350.
The scalar k_pot envelope is not presented as T^4<=C K^4; local/full finite quotients are reported precisely to expose this remaining step.
The 30 matrix rows inherit only the registered finite volumes, oscillator cutoffs, beta values and radii; no asymptotic bound is inferred from their extrema.
R350 checks rational inequality composition only; it does not formalize matrix quotients, Gibbs traces, unbounded domains or limits.
The result does not close a local Gibbs moment, direct D/delta-D history, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
